title: Agent schedule
lede: When M365Mutator runs as an Agent 365 agent, it has no admin UI. It follows this schedule instead, running the enabled workloads one after another at each interval. Save it to this machine's data folder, or export a bundle to deploy to the hosted agent.
envOverride: The M365MUTATOR_SCHEDULE_JSON setting is set on this server. In agent mode it takes precedence over the schedule saved here.

timing.title: When to run
timing.subtitle: Each cycle starts one interval after the previous one was due, moved randomly by up to the jitter.
timing.disabled: Schedule off: the agent runs nothing
timing.runOnStart: Run a cycle as soon as the agent starts

window.toggle: Only run during an active window
window.endHint: An end earlier than the start runs past midnight

workloads.title: What to run
workloads.subtitle: Each enabled workload runs the given number of times per cycle, as the identity you choose.
workloads.identitiesBlocked: Identities can't run on a schedule: agent identities can't hold User.ReadWrite.All.
workloads.agentWarningTitle: Agent identity writes will fail for now
workloads.agentWarning: Exchange Online and SharePoint currently reject agent identity tokens (HTTP 401). Workloads set to write as the agent identity will fail until Microsoft supports this. Use the app registration for now.
workloads.targetsNote: Targets come from each workload's page. The exported bundle includes them.

deletions.dateHint: YYYY-MM-DD, or relative to each run: -30d, -2w
deletions.acknowledge: I understand this permanently deletes the matching items every cycle, with no further confirmation.

review.title: Check and deploy
review.subtitle: Changes are checked as you make them.
review.disabled: The schedule is off, so the agent won't run anything.
review.jitterNote: Each run can move up to {{jitter}} minutes either way.
review.nothingEnabled: No workloads are enabled, so cycles will do nothing.

actions.exportHint: Download a zip with schedule.json, targets.json and the equivalent App Service settings
actions.runOnceHint: Runs this schedule's workloads once from this machine, as the agent would. This changes the tenant.

status.blocked: The agent identity couldn't get a token, so nothing ran
